 % Spectral simulation Chan180_S4_B3
 % 
 % Papers: 
 % 
 % 1. A.W. Vreman and J.G.M. Kuerten, Comparison of DNS databases of turbulent 
 %    channel flow at Re_tau=180, Phys. Fluids 26, 015102 (2014). 
 % 2. A.W. Vreman and J.G.M. Kuerten, Statistics of spatial derivatives of 
 %    velocity and pressure in turbulent channel flow, Phys. Fluids 26, 
 %    085103 (2014).
 % 3. A.W. Vreman and J.G.M. Kuerten, A third-order multistep time 
 %    discretization for a Cheyshev tau spectral method. 
 % 
 % The simulations "*_B3" were performed with a modified spectral method: 
 %  - The time discretization scheme was replaced by the third-order time 
 %    discretization scheme B3, defined in Ref. 3 mentioned above. 
 %  - The right-hand side of the pressure Poisson equation was -u_{i,k}u_{k,i}
 %    (instead of minus the divergence of the rotational form of the
 %    convective terms). Thus the Laplacian of the pressure is zero to 
 %    machine precision at the walls, which leads to improved behaviour of  
 %    higher-order moments of pressure derivatives in the first few grid 
 %    points of the wall. The pressure Poisson equation was used for 
 %    post-processing only. 
 %

 %
